deepseek7b.method_note: Patch top, matched, or random source units from donor into baseline at answer-site source tensors. Attention units are o_proj input head slices; MLP units are down_proj input activation channels. Top source units are ranked by Phase786-style signed readout contribution. Matched controls are selected inside the same layer/component by source magnitude and activation-delta norm.
deepseek7b.strict_interpretation: This phase upgrades random controls to matched source-unit controls. It validates answer-site source-unit specificity only; it still does not prove full Q/K/V or cross-position semantic fibers.
deepseek7b.title: Matched Source Unit Causal Fiber Validation
